	COLDWAR_COL_support_trigger_gui = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_COL_support_trigger_window"
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view
		visible = { COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes }
		effects = {
			COLDWAR_COL_open_support_click = {
				set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_target = THIS.id }
				ROOT = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes set_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_open }
			}
		}
	}
	COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_gui = {
		context_type = selected_state_context
		window_name = "COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_window"
		properties = {
			COLDWAR_COL_movement_emblem = { image = "[COLDWAR_COL_GetMovementEmblem]" }
		}
		parent_window_token = selected_state_view
		visible = {
			COLDWAR_COL_foreign_contact_visible = yes
			ROOT = {
				has_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_open
				check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = PREV.id }
			}
		}
		effects = {
			COLDWAR_COL_close_support_click = {
				ROOT = { clr_country_flag = COLDWAR_COL_support_panel_open }
			}
			COLDWAR_COL_support_political_click = {
				set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_target = THIS.id }
				ROOT = {
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_support_political = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_COL_support_funding_click = {
				set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_target = THIS.id }
				ROOT = {
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_support_funding = yes
					COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_COL_support_arms_click = {
				set_variable = { ROOT.COLDWAR_COL_support_target = THIS.id }
				ROOT = { COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes COLDWAR_COL_support_arms = yes COLDWAR_COL_refresh_support_target = yes }
			}
		}
		triggers = {
			COLDWAR_COL_support_political_click_enabled = {
				ROOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = PREV.id }
					COLDWAR_COL_can_support_political = yes
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_COL_support_funding_click_enabled = {
				ROOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = PREV.id }
					COLDWAR_COL_can_support_funding = yes
				}
			}
			COLDWAR_COL_support_arms_click_enabled = {
				ROOT = {
					check_variable = { COLDWAR_COL_support_target = PREV.id }
					COLDWAR_COL_can_support_arms = yes
				}
			}
		}
